mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, host, port, username, password_encryption_algorithm, password_encrypted_payload, password_initialization_vector, password_key_version, from_address, from_name, use_tls, updated_at FROM mail_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_settings ( id, enabled, host, port, username, password_encryption_algorithm, password_encrypted_payload, password_initialization_vector, password_key_version, from_address, from_name, use_tls, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{enabled}, #{host}, #{port}, #{username}, #{passwordEncryptionAlgorithm}, #{passwordEncryptedPayload}, #{passwordInitializationVector}, #{passwordKeyVersion}, #{fromAddress}, #{fromName}, #{useTls}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, host = EXCLUDED.host, port = EXCLUDED.port, username = EXCLUDED.username, password_encryption_algorithm = EXCLUDED.password_encryption_algorithm, password_encrypted_payload = EXCLUDED.password_encrypted_payload, password_initialization_vector = EXCLUDED.password_initialization_vector, password_key_version = EXCLUDED.password_key_version, from_address = EXCLUDED.from_address, from_name = EXCLUDED.from_name, use_tls = EXCLUDED.use_tls, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
